note: Intended design for one root cause with two sightings. Slice A derives plan readiness at read time (contract.planWritten -> Feature.PlanUnwritten -> Feature.Authoring()); Slice B moves each phase's status write from exit to ENTRY and makes the concurrency cap key on a live gogo-go session rather than the file-derived class. Neither adds a status enum value, so the frozen contract's status enum, the four work-index classes and the class->column mapping are unchanged.

diagrams.title: Intended control flow: the plan.md check feeds the pill, the gate count, the m action and the /gogo:accept gate; the new session-action parser feeds the cap and the building cue
Intended timing of a build: gogo-implement writes phase=implement/status=implementing at ENTRY (step 1b) instead of at exit, and the cap counts the live gogo-go session
Work-item lifecycle with the derived authoring state before acceptance and the corrected entry-write transitions after it
